chunks: And with this chain of narration, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from 'Asim ibn Hamid, from Abu Ishaq al-Nahawi, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: Indeed, Allah educated His Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) according to His liking, so He said: 'And indeed, you are of a great moral character.'
And whatever the Messenger has given you, take it; and whatever he has forbidden you, refrain from it.
And He said: 'Whoever obeys the Messenger has certainly obeyed Allah.'

And indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) delegated authority to Ali (peace be upon him) and entrusted him with it, so you submitted (to his authority) while the people denied (it).

By Allah, we love that you say when we say, and keep silent when we keep silent. We are the mediators between you and Allah, and Allah has not made any goodness for anyone in contradicting His command.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Imams being mediators between Allah and the believers?
ai.summary: This narration from Fadail al-Shia establishes the theological concept of *Tawfiy* (delegation), illustrating how divine authority flowed from Allah to the Prophet, and then to Imam Ali, positioning the Imams as the essential mediators between the Creator and the creation. It underscores the practical implication of *Ta'ah* (obedience), where the Imams' silence commands the believers' silence, reinforcing their unique status as the living proof of God on earth.

en.badr-shahin: (The same previous series of relaters) …from al-Hasan bin Ali from Aassim bin Hamid that Abu Ishaq an-Nahawi (the grammarian) said
that he heard Abu Abdullah (a) saying: Allah educated His Prophet (s) as He liked for him. He says: "You have attained a high moral standard [68:4]."
Allah then authorized him to represent Him. He says: "Take only what the Messenger gives to you and desist from what he forbids you [59:7]."
"One who obeys the Messenger has certainly obeyed Allah [4:80]."
In the same manner, the Prophet (s) authorized Ali (a) to represent him and deposited with him (all the religious affairs). You submitted (to this authority) while the others denied.

By Allah I swear, we do love you to say when we say and keep silent when we keep silent. We are the mediators between Allah and you. Allah has never made any goodness lie in the contradiction to His commandments.
